description: Address review feedback: (1) Add Affected field to OSVEntryDetail in Go and TypeScript models, populate in store, display in OSV entry tab panels. (2) Add overflow-x-auto to tablist container for narrow viewport scrolling. (3) Add multi-entry test case to component spec.
steps: 1. In internal/model/detail.go, add Affected []Affected field to OSVEntryDetail struct.
2. In internal/store/detail.go, populate entry.Affected from vuln.Affected for each OSV entry.
3. In ui/src/app/models/vulnerability.model.ts, add affected?: Affected[] to OsvEntryDetail interface.
4. In vulnerability-detail.component.html, add overflow-x-auto to the tablist container div.
5. In vulnerability-detail.component.html, add affected packages section to the OSV entry tab panel.
6. In vulnerability-detail.component.spec.ts, add test case with osv_entries array of 2 entries verifying tabs and content switching.
acceptance_criteria: OSVEntryDetail Go struct has Affected []Affected field
OSVEntryDetail TypeScript interface has affected?: Affected[] field
Each OSV entry in OsvEntries is populated with its Affected data
Tab bar container has overflow-x-auto class for horizontal scroll
OSV entry tab panel displays affected packages when present
Test with 2+ osv_entries verifies correct number of tabs and content switching
